fusions.name: Stubble Cut
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Throws a reaping arc at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Second Cutting
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%). Each heal has a 10% chance to be critical.

fusions.name: Harvest Tally
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next 2 spells deal 25% more damage. Once every 5 seconds.
